payload.title: removeLoRaDevice and sendLoRaDownlink take edgeDeviceId from the caller and use it as the MQTT target without comparing it with the LoRa device's stored edgeDeviceId, so within one tenant the update_lora_devices push or the lora_downlink command goes to a gateway that does not own the device and the real parent is never told.
evidence: apps/sensor-service/src/edge-device/edge-device.service.ts:2367-2385 (removeLoRaDevice finds the device by {id, tenantId}, deletes it, then pushes to deviceRepository.findOne({where: {id: edgeDeviceId}}) with the caller's id)
apps/sensor-service/src/edge-device/edge-device.service.ts:2444-2475 (sendLoRaDownlink finds the LoRa device by {id, tenantId} and the gateway by the caller's edgeDeviceId, with no parent comparison)
apps/sensor-service/src/edge-device/edge-device.service.ts:2491-2501 (lora_downlink is published to the caller-chosen gateway's command topic)

apps/sensor-service/src/edge-device/edge-device.service.ts:2322-2323 (addLoRaDevice validates the edge device with findByIdOrFail and stores it as the parent, so its push at 2355 targets the real parent and is not affected)
payload.rule_violated: A relation must be derived from the stored parent, not trusted from a caller-supplied duplicate of it (the LoRa device row already carries edgeDeviceId).
payload.notes: In one tenant with gateways E1 and E2 and LoRa device L1 on E1, a TENANT_ADMIN or MODULE_MANAGER request removeLoRaDevice(edgeDeviceId: E2, loraDeviceId: L1) deletes L1, rebuilds and pushes E2's own LoRa list to E2, and never pushes to E1, whose agent keeps L1 provisioned until some later push; sendLoRaDownlink(E2, L1) publishes the downlink with L1's devAddr to E2's command topic. It is not cross-tenant (both tables are per-tenant and routed by search_path) and the UI sends the right pair, so it needs a crafted or stale request. Close condition: Take the push and publish target from device.edgeDeviceId (the stored parent) in removeLoRaDevice and sendLoRaDownlink and refuse a supplied edgeDeviceId that differs; tests: removing L1 with E2 throws and publishes nothing, removing it with E1 pushes to E1, and sendLoRaDownlink(E2, L1) returns an error without a publish. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
